title: Fantasy Player News
description: Breaking Fantasy Football player news along with the impact for fantasy managers

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Azeez Al-Shaair (groin) will play Sunday
items.desc: Azeez Al-Shaair (groin) will play in Sunday's game against the New York Giants.
items.impact: Al-Shaair was listed on the team's injury report throughout the week due to a nagging groin issue, but it won't stop him from playing in Week 7 and he is now off of the injury report entirely. Houston's defense will be better with him available to suit up and start.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Jalen Pitre (shoulder) unavailable for Sunday
items.desc: Jalen Pitre (shoulder) is unavailable for Sunday's game against the New York Giants.
items.impact: The Texans will be without one of their key defenders on Sunday with Pitre set to be sidelined due to a shoulder issue. Their secondary will be weaker than usual for however long he's out of the lineup.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Tank Dell (knee) officially listed questionable for Sunday
items.desc: Tank Dell (knee) is officially listed as questionable to play in Sunday's game against the New York Giants.
items.impact: Dell is officially listed questionable to play on Sunday, but it was reported earlier in the week that he is going to play, so it seems likely that he is going to suit up against the Giants. Fantasy managers shouldn't expect him to be fantasy relevant even if active, however.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Reed Blankenship (concussion/hand) out for Week 7
items.desc: Reed Blankenship (concussion/hand) is out for Sunday's game against the New York Giants.
items.impact: As expected, Blankenship is going to be sidelined on Sunday as he continues to recover from a concussion and a hand issue. Houston's secondary will be short-handed while he's out.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Brevin Jordan (foot) set to play Sunday
items.desc: Brevin Jordan (foot) is set to play in Sunday's game against the New York Giants.
items.impact: Jordan popped up on the injury report in the middle of the week due to a foot issue, but it's not a serious issue and he will play on Sunday. He isn't expected to be a relevant fantasy option anytime soon, however.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: David Montgomery (groin) ruled out for Sunday
items.desc: David Montgomery (groin) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the New York Giants.
items.impact: The veteran running back is going to miss another game on Sunday. He's still dealing with a groin issue of some kind, and it remains to be seen how much longer it will leave him sidelined. Woody Marks and Jawhar Jordan will both continue to see more work for however long Montgomery remains sidelined.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Blake Fisher (thumb) sidelined for Sunday
items.desc: Blake Fisher (thumb) will be sidelined for Sunday's game against the New York Giants.
items.impact: The veteran was sidelined at practice all week due to a thumb issue, and it will officially leave him sidelined for Sunday's game against the Giants. Houston's offensive front will be weaker than usual with him out of the lineup.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Trent Brown (wrist) cleared to play Sunday
items.desc: Trent Brown (wrist) was cleared to play in Sunday's game against the New York Giants.
items.impact: The veteran lineman will be good to go for Week 7, despite missing a practice earlier in the week due to a wrist issue. He will continue to be a key starter on Houston's offensive front moving forward.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Dalton Schultz (quad) good to go Sunday
items.desc: Dalton Schultz (quad) is good to go for Sunday's game against the New York Giants.
items.impact: The veteran was dealing with a quad injury at practice throughout the week, but it's not a serious issue at this point and won't prevent him from playing in Week 7. He will continue to be a decent week-to-week streaming option in PPR formats moving forward.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Nick Bosa (knee/calf) ruled out for Sunday
items.desc: Nick Bosa (knee/calf) was ruled out for Sunday's game against the Atlanta Falcons.
items.impact: Bosa will miss yet another game while recovering from a pair of injuries. San Francisco's defensive front will continue to operate at less than full capacity until he's back in the lineup.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Christian Kirk (calf) questionable for Sunday
items.desc: Christian Kirk (calf) is questionable for Sunday's game against the Atlanta Falcons.
items.impact: Kirk has yet to make his debut for the 49ers this season, but it may come on Sunday, as he is officially considered questionable to play against the Falcons. If he's cleared to play, he will likely be in line for a good amount of work right away with Mike Evans (ribs/Achilles) and Deebo Samuel Sr. (hamstring) both currently sidelined for San Francisco.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Deebo Samuel Sr. (hamstring) won't play Sunday
items.desc: Deebo Samuel Sr. (hamstring) won't play in Sunday's game against the Atlanta Falcons.
items.impact: As expected, the veteran is going to miss another game on Sunday as he continues to nurse a hamstring injury. QB Brock Purdy doesn't project to be as strong of a fantasy option this week with him and Mike Evans (ribs/Achilles) ruled out for this matchup against the Falcons.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Mike Evans (ribs/Achilles) ruled out for Sunday
items.desc: Mike Evans (ribs/Achilles) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Atlanta Falcons.
items.impact: Evans is not going to be available to play on Sunday. He aggravated his Achilles injury last week, and with the team's bye week coming up in Week 8, they deemed it best to let him sit out this week to recover. Christian Kirk (calf) and Brandin Cooks will both see more work while he's out.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Matthew Golden (shoulder) off injury report for Sunday
items.desc: Matthew Golden (shoulder) is off of the injury report for Sunday's game against the Detroit Lions.
items.impact: As expected, Golden is officially off of Green Bay's injury report and good to go for Week 7. He will play against the Lions and should be started in nearly all league formats at this point in the season.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Bo Melton (back) questionable to play Sunday
items.desc: Bo Melton (back) is questionable to play in Sunday's game against the Detroit Lions.
items.impact: Melton is uncertain to play on Sunday due to the back injury that is currently bothering him. If he's ruled out ahead of game time, Savion Williams may see more work as a result of his absence, though not likely enough to be a relevant fantasy option.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Savion Williams (ankle) will play Sunday
items.desc: Savion Williams (ankle) will play in Sunday's game against the Detroit Lions.
items.impact: Williams is going to be available to play on Sunday, despite managing an ankle injury earlier in the week. He isn't expected to see a lot of work against the Lions, however, though his workload will increase if Bo Melton (back) is ruled out ahead of game time.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Christian Watson (ankle) officially cleared to play Sunday
items.desc: Christian Watson (ankle) has officially been cleared to play in Sunday's game against the Detroit Lions.
items.impact: The star wideout is officially off of the team's injury report and will be available to play on Sunday. Fantasy managers should feel good starting him in what projects to be a great matchup against the Lions on Sunday.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Jordan Love (back) without injury designation for Sunday
items.desc: Jordan Love (back) is without an injury designation for Sunday's game against the Detroit Lions.
items.impact: Love was managing a minor back issue early on in the week, but to no surprise, he carries no injury designation heading into the weekend and will be good to go for Sunday's game. He should be considered a solid streaming option this week in a favorable matchup against Detroit.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Aaron Banks (knee/toe) listed questionable for Sunday
items.desc: Aaron Banks (knee/toe) is listed questionable for Sunday's game against the Detroit Lions.
items.impact: Banks has been sidelined for close to a month while dealing with various injuries. He may be back in the lineup on Sunday, however, as he is officially considered questionable to play against Detroit. Green Bay's offensive front will see a nice boost whenever he's back in the lineup for them.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Andrew Vorhees (foot) will play Sunday
items.desc: Andrew Vorhees (foot) will play in Sunday's game against the Cincinnati Bengals.
items.impact: The veteran is off of the injury report and will be available to play on Sunday. Cam Jurgens is set to make his debut for the Ravens in this game, however, meaning that Vorhees is not expected to be a starter for the foreseeable future.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: John Simpson (groin) available to play Sunday
items.desc: John Simpson (groin) will be available to play in Sunday's game against the Cincinnati Bengals.
items.impact: Simpson is going to play on Sunday, which was the expectation since the beginning of the week. Baltimore's offensive line seems to be mostly healthy for Week 7, so it's quite possible that they will look better than usual in a tough divisional matchup against the Bengals this week.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Cam Jurgens (concussion) set to play Sunday
items.desc: Cam Jurgens (concussion) is set to play in Sunday's game against the Cincinnati Bengals.
items.impact: Jurgens was recently recovering from a concussion, but he has since cleared the NFL's concussion protocols and will be available to make his debut for the Ravens in Week 7. The interior of their offensive line should see a nice boost moving forward with him now healthy and in the lineup.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Ronnie Stanley (toe/ankle) cleared to play Sunday
items.desc: Ronnie Stanley (toe/ankle) has been cleared to play in Sunday's game against the Cincinnati Bengals.
items.impact: Stanley was listed on team's the injury report throughout the week, but the injuries that he's managing aren't serious and won't prevent him from playing in Week 7. His presence will be especially important if QB Lamar Jackson (ankle) is back behind center this week.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Rashod Bateman (shoulder) good to go for Sunday
items.desc: Rashod Bateman (shoulder) is good to go for Sunday's game against the Cincinnati Bengals.
items.impact: Bateman will be good to go for Sunday's game after being limited by a shoulder issue earlier in the week. He isn't expected to be a trustworthy fantasy option in this game, however, though his ceiling will be raised considerably if QB Lamar Jackson (ankle) is cleared to play ahead of game time.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Lamar Jackson (ankle) officially questionable for Sunday
items.desc: Lamar Jackson (ankle) is officially questionable for Sunday's game against the Cincinnati Bengals.
items.impact: Jackson has missed the past couple of games due to an ankle injury, but he is officially questionable for Week 7 and will have a chance to make his return to the lineup on Sunday. All of Baltimore's relevant fantasy options will see a nice boost if he's back in the lineup this week, even if he's slightly limited by the lingering effects of his injury.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Calvin Ridley (hip) listed questionable for Sunday
items.desc: Calvin Ridley (hip) is listed questionable for Sunday's game against the Cleveland Cavaliers.
items.impact: The veteran has been dealing with a hip injury throughout practice this week and will be questionable to play on Sunday as a result. His potential absence wouldn't carry much weight from a fantasy perspective, however.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Tyjae Spears (knee) questionable to play Sunday
items.desc: Tyjae Spears (knee) is questionable to play in Sunday's game against the Cleveland Cavaliers.
items.impact: The Titans may not have Spears on Sunday, as he is currently considered questionable to play due to a nagging knee issue of some kind. If he's ruled out, Tony Pollard will dominate the touches in this backfield.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Mike Washington Jr. (foot/back) expected to play Sunday
items.desc: Mike Washington Jr. (foot/back) is expected to play in Sunday's game against the Los Angeles Rams.
items.impact: Washington missed Thursday's practice due to a pair of injuries that he's dealing with, but HC Klint Kubiak told reporters that he expects the young running back to play on Sunday, though the team will give him a pregame evaluation to ensure that he's healthy enough to suit up. Assuming he's active, he will continue to be an involved RB2 on this offense behind Ashton Jeanty, though he doesn't project to have much fantasy value in this particular matchup.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Ogbo Okoronkwo released by 49ers
items.desc: Ogbo Okoronkwo has been released by the San Francisco 49ers.
items.impact: The 49ers made the decision to release Okoronkwo on Friday and he will hit the open market as a free agent. It remains to be seen if he will land anywhere throughout the remainder of the regular season.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Tyler Steen (shoulder) practicing Friday
items.desc: Tyler Steen (shoulder) is practicing for the Eagles on Friday.
items.impact: Steen was seen practicing for the Eagles on Friday, which was to be expected. It looks like he is trending towards being active in Week 7, which would be good news for Philadelphia's offense ahead of a matchup against Dallas on Monday night.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: DeVonta Smith (hamstring) not practicing Friday
items.desc: DeVonta Smith (hamstring) is not taking part in Philadelphia's practice on Friday.
items.impact: The veteran wideout is not taking part in the team's practice for a second-straight day on Friday, which raises some questions about his availability for Week 7. Fantasy managers should keep close tabs on updates about his health throughout the rest of the week to see if he will play on Monday night or not.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Jalyx Hunt (knee/ankle) taking part in practice Friday
items.desc: Jalyx Hunt (knee/ankle) is taking part in Philadelphia's practice on Friday.
items.impact: Hunt is taking part in Philadelphia's practice on Friday after missing a bit of time recently with a pair of injuries. It looks like he's gearing up to play in Week 7, assuming he suffers no setbacks at practice throughout the week.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Landon Dickerson (knee/pec) participating at practice Friday
items.desc: Landon Dickerson (knee/pec) is participating in Philadelphia's practice on Friday.
items.impact: As expected, Dickerson is taking part in Friday's practice in some capacity. It looks like he is strongly trending towards playing on Monday night, though we won't know for sure until later on in the week.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Dontayvion Wicks (ankle) absent from practice Friday
items.desc: Dontayvion Wicks (ankle) was absent from Philadelphia's practice on Friday.
items.impact: Wicks was not spotted at another practice session on Friday, which will mark the second-straight day that he has been a non-participant. His ankle injury may very well leave him sidelined this week, which would lead to more opportunities for rookie Makai Lemon against the Cowboys.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Saquon Barkley (hamstring) practicing again Friday
items.desc: Saquon Barkley (hamstring) is taking part in Philadelphia's practice again on Friday.
items.impact: Barkley is practicing in a second-straight practice on Friday. It's unclear whether or not he is limited in any capacity, but either way, this is a good sign that he will be back in the lineup for Monday night's game against Dallas.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Dallas Goedert (knee) not practicing Friday
items.desc: Dallas Goedert (knee) is not taking part in Philadelphia's practice on Friday.
items.impact: The veteran tight end is not practicing for the Eagles again on Friday. He will have one more chance to log at least a limited practice on Saturday before the team's game on Monday night, but if he's not able to, it's likely that he will be sidelined for the team's primetime matchup against Dallas in Week 7.

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.title: Cole Kmet (knee) out for the season with knee injury
items.desc: Cole Kmet (knee) is out for the season with a knee injury, HC Ben Johnson confirmed on Friday.
items.impact: Kmet was scheduled to undergo testing on his injured knee and it revealed what many suspected, a season ending injury,m. What injury he has exactly we don't know, but it's sounding like it will be a long road to recovery for the Bears tight end. Colston Loveland will maintain his prominent role, and Sam Roush will see additional snaps in his absence.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Dylan Sampson (knee) expected to play Sunday
items.desc: Dylan Sampson (knee) is expected to play in Sunday's game against the Tennessee Titans.
items.impact: Sampson is officially listed as questionable to play heading into the weekend due to a knee issue of some kind, but he is reportedly expected to play and should suit up against Tennessee. He will continue to be nothing more than a depth piece in this backfield for the foreseeable future, however.

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.title: Puka Nacua (calf) questionable for Sunday
items.desc: Puka Nacua (calf) is questionable for the Rams game against the Raiders with a calf injury.
items.impact: While the calf injury was originally reported to be minor, it seems like that might have been a flat out lie. Puka could still be just fine and see a boatload of targets, but the certainty of his availability just took a big hit. Fantasy managers will need to keep a close eye on his status, especially as his game is in the late afternoon window.

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.title: Rashee Rice (hamstring/knee) out for Week 7
items.desc: Rashee Rice (hamstring/knee) is out for the Chiefs Week 7 game against the Seahawks on Sunday.
items.impact: Rice will miss a second straight game due to injury, leaving Xavier Worthy, Jalen Royals, and Cyrus Allen to face off against the Seattle Seahawks secondary. Worthy should at least get some short area PPR scam targets, making him a flex option, but the other receivers are not reliable enough to start as of this moment.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Jeremiyah Love (ankle) ruled out for Week 7
items.desc: Jeremiyah Love (ankle) has been ruled out for Week 7 for the Arizona Cardinals according to Bo Brack.
items.impact: Love will be sidelined once again for Arizona, with Tyler Allgeier in line for a featured backfield role against the Denver Broncos Sunday.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Brock Bowers (hamstring/calf) practicing Friday
items.desc: Brock Bowers (hamstring/calf) is practicing Friday for the Las Vegas Raiders according to Sam Warren.
items.impact: Bowers logged another full practice session after suffering the hamstring and calf injuries earlier in the week, putting the tight end in line as one of the more dynamic weapons in the Raiders offense against a banged-up Rams defense in Week 7.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Quinshon Judkins (ankle) off injury report for Week 7
items.desc: Quinshon Judkins (ankle) is off of the injury report for Week 7 for the Cleveland Browns according to Mary Kay Cabot.
items.impact: Judkins is good to go after increasing reps in practice throughout the week for head coach Todd Monken, setting the running back up to lead a Cleveland backfield that could be missing Dylan Sampson (knee) against the Titans Sunday.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Brian Robinson Jr. (hamstring) ruled out for Week 7
items.desc: Brian Robinson Jr. (hamstring) has been ruled out for Week 7 by the Atlanta Falcons according to Will McFadden.
items.impact: Robinson Jr. will not suit up after struggling to progress through the practice week for head coach Kevin Stefanski, resulting in No. 1 running back Bijan Robinson likely to receive even more touches out of the backfield in Week 7.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Zaire Franklin (shin) ruled out for Week 7
items.desc: Zaire Franklin (shin) has been ruled out for Week 7 for the Green Bay Packers according to Ari Meirov.
items.impact: Franklin took a knee to his shin during practice and will now be sidelined for a key NFC North divisional battle against a high-powered Lions offense Sunday.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Emeka Egbuka (concussion/foot) ruled out for Week 7
items.desc: Emeka Egbuka (concussion/foot) has been ruled out for Week 7 by the Tampa Bay Buccaneers according to Greg Auman.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Tyler Warren (groin) ruled out for Week 7
items.desc: Tyler Warren (groin) has been ruled out for Week 7 by the Indianapolis Colts according to Adam Schefter.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Sam Franklin Jr. has suspension reduced
items.desc: Sam Franklin Jr. had his suspension reduced to a $14,926 fine according to Adam Schefter.
items.impact: Franklin Jr. was part of multiple Buffalo defenders that engaged in unsportsmanlike conduct against the Las Vegas Raiders, ultimately resulting in the fine after a league hearing.

items.author: Nate Miller
items.title: Drake Maye accounts for three touchdowns in Week 7 loss
items.desc: Drake Maye completed 24 of 31 passes for 321 yards with two touchdowns and one interception, adding 26 yards and another touchdown on four carries during Thursday's 30-24 loss to the Bears.
items.impact: The Patriots certainly wanted the win, but fantasy managers enjoyed a big performance from Maye. The third-year QB threw for more than 300 yards for the second time in the last three weeks, and he's now scored 11 total touchdowns during that span. Maye will be a certain start at Miami in Week 8.
